title: ACP Task
description: One ACP (Agent Client Protocol) session driven by the backend supervisor, stored as an acp_task:<id> document. Writable fields request work: create with status 'queued' to start a session; append a message to steer a working turn or start the next turn when idle; write {prompt, status: 'queued'} to run the next turn on the same session; write {cancel_requested: true} to cancel. Read-only fields are owned by the supervisor.

task_id.description: The id part of the acp_task:<id> key.

cwd.description: Working directory on the agent's host, e.g. a repo node's worktree path. Defaults to the agent's configured cwd.

card_id.description: Kanban card this task works for, if any.

status.description: queued: a turn is requested; working: a turn is running; completed/failed/canceled: the last turn ended; interrupted: the backend restarted during the turn (queue another turn to resume the session).

cancel_requested.description: Set true to cancel the running or queued turn; reset to false by the supervisor.

messages.description: Messages appended by requesters for injection into a running turn or the next turn when idle.

mode.description: Requested session mode, applied when a session starts or resumes and while it is running.

answers.description: Answers keyed by a supervisor-created pending_input id.

notify_on_completion.description: Tell Progenitor's chat when a turn ends.

session_id.description: ACP session id; later turns resume it.

output.description: Agent reply text of the last finished turn.

summary.description: First line of the last output.

progress.description: Live progress of the current turn, saved periodically.

stalled.description: True while a working turn has shown no agent activity for PROGENITOR_ACP_STALL_SECONDS.

history.description: Finished turns: turn, status, prompt, output, summary, stop_reason, last_error, completed_at.

pending_input.description: Human input currently requested by the agent, or null.
